errors: Age-based retention does not guarantee exactly seven backups when runs are missed or additional backups are created.
Using .Config.Image selects an image reference that may have changed, so it does not guarantee the exact production image.
A.note: The complete procedure and isolated restore test are easy to follow, although some guarantees are overstated.

errors: Age-based retention does not guarantee that the seven most recent nightly backups are always retained.
Using .Config.Image does not guarantee the exact production image if its tag has changed.
The restore test skips privileges but preserves ownership, so objects owned by absent roles can cause failure.
The automated test prints restored row counts without comparing them to production and leaves the freshness query disabled, so successful execution does not establish all stated passing conditions.
Omitting published ports does not isolate the test container from the host or other containers on its bridge network.
B.note: The automation is useful and well explained, but the restore test has ownership and validation gaps.
